newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Filinvest Land falls 8.89 pct in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Filinvest Land falls 8.89 pct in late trade.

text.p: Filinvest Land Inc fell to an 18-month low in late trade on Tuesday, shedding 40 centavos, or 8.89 percent, to 4.10 pesos on concerns of the negative effect of foreign exchange volatility on the property market, brokers said.
"Fears of rising interest rates will exacerbate the property glut scare," said Noel Reyes, research head at Anscor-Hagedorn Securities.
Filinvest was one of the most heavily traded issues of the day.
Traders said that the issue suffered along with the rest of the property sector.
Property was the worst hit sector of the market, sinking 26.14 points, or 2.17 percent, to 1,180.20 points late in the session.
